narrative.overview: Suot Isla ("Island Wear") pairs tactile Philippine coastal material warmth with crisp e-commerce and operations clarity. Rather than generic sterile white fast-fashion templates or dark neon SaaS dashboards, every surface is grounded in Warm Sand (#F4EAD5), bleached linen (#FAF6EE), and Deep Lagoon Teal (#0E6B74), accented by Sun-Bleached Coral (#F27D63) for low-stock urgency and Palm Leaf Green (#2E5A44) on Seafoam Mist (#A8D5BA) for island fulfillment tracking.
keyCharacteristics: Warm Sand (#F4EAD5) and bleached linen (#FAF6EE) structural grounds with zero pure gray (#666) or stark #000/#fff contrast.
Circular woven-stitch stamp badge emblem featuring a clean horizon sun arc and curling ocean wave.
Tabular monospace specs (JetBrains Mono) for SKUs, PHP (₱) prices, tracking numbers, and coordinates.
Single-elevation discipline: resting cards use a 1px solid #D8C8AA border without drop shadows; floating drawers and modals use soft lagoon-tinted depth without borders.

rules.name: The Tinted Shore Rule
rules.body: Never use pure gray (#666, #999) or pure black (#000). Every text, border, and surface neutral is tinted with either Deep Lagoon Teal (#092C30, #24494E) or Warm Sand (#D8C8AA).

rules.name: The Self-Sufficient Heading Rule
rules.body: Headings never carry small uppercase kicker or eyebrow labels above them; each heading establishes hierarchy through scale, weight, and generous top margin.

rules.name: The No-Ghost-Card Rule
rules.body: Declare elevation once—either a 1px border on resting surface cards or a soft shadow on floating overlays, never both on the same element.

dos: Do pair Deep Lagoon Teal (#0E6B74) primary actions with Warm Sand (#F4EAD5) and Bleached Linen (#FAF6EE) surfaces.
Do use font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums on all prices, SKUs, stock counts, and order tables.
Do trigger an entry in the Customer Email Notification Outbox whenever an order is placed, shipped, cancelled, or refunded.
donts: Don't place small uppercase eyebrow/kicker labels above h1–h6 headings.
Don't combine a 1px border and a box-shadow on the same card.
Don't use pure gray (#666, #888) or stark #000000 text on coastal sand surfaces.
